name: Nath Industries Limited
about: Nath Industries Limited manufactures and sells industrial and specialty papers and industrial chemicals in India. It operates through two segments: Paper and Industrial Chemicals. The company offers Rama paper products, such as absorbent saturating kraft, laminated sheet, MG white tissue sheet, OTC multi-layer carbonizing, colour tissue 18 GSM, and kraft grocery bags; nath paper products, including edge protector/angel board, coated one side, DTY tubes, paper cones, thermal papers, POY/FDY tubes, and film cores; and labsa and thionyl chloride. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Rama Pulp and Papers Limited and changed its name to Nath Industries Limited in October 2019. Nath Industries Limited is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
